brief: A seed-starting tray of at least four cells, each with a draining bin.

requirements.requirement: At least four cells in the tray
requirements.evidence: 4 hex bases placed at 0,0; 0,-1; 1,0; 0,1 forming contiguous tray

requirements.requirement: Each cell has a draining bin
requirements.evidence: bins bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-drain, bin:0,-1,0~hex-bin-full-drain, bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full-drain, bin:0,1,0~hex-bin-full-drain all variant hex-bin-full-drain with drain holes

finish.summary: Built 4-cell seed-starting tray using full hex bases in a compact cluster, each fitted with a full-depth drained bin (hex-bin-full-drain) allowing water to drain, filled with soil and planted with seedlings for demonstration; caps closed open faces, joints locked.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
